transcript.statement: Trustworthiness is paramount in the ATM system, ensuring that all transactions are encrypted (TRU-01) to protect user data during transmission. Secure user authentication (TRU-02) is essential to prevent unauthorized access. Logging transactions with timestamps (TRU-03) supports auditability, while preventing negative balances (TRU-04) aligns with user expectations of account integrity. Users should have secure access to their transaction history (TRU-05) and receive notifications of insufficient funds (TRU-06) for informed decision-making. Lastly, maintaining data integrity (TRU-07) upholds the trust between the bank and its clients.

requirements.text: The ATM system shall ensure no account can have a negative balance during transactions.
The ATM system shall provide users with notifications about insufficient funds after a withdrawal request.
The ATM system shall automatically withdraw funds from a related savings account only when sufficient funds are available.
The ATM system shall log all transactions with date, time, type, amount, and resulting balance for audit purposes.
The ATM system shall encrypt all transactions during transmission to protect user data.
The ATM system shall comply with applicable financial regulations and standards during all transactions.
The ATM system shall provide a mechanism for securely reviewing transaction history.
The ATM system shall implement energy-efficient operations to minimize carbon footprint.
The ATM system shall optimize data retrieval to reduce latency while minimizing data storage requirements.
The ATM system shall ensure immediate transaction processing within 3 seconds.
The ATM system shall maintain a transaction throughput of at least 100 transactions per minute.
The ATM system shall implement load balancing to manage transaction requests effectively.
The ATM system shall provide an option for clients to receive electronic transaction records.
The ATM system shall implement secure PIN verification for user authentication.
The ATM system shall automatically shut down during periods of inactivity to save energy.
The ATM system shall assess its environmental impact annually and report findings to stakeholders.
